name: Silica
author: Silica Plugin

sections.description:
Silica makes it easy to create beautiful, modern glassmorphism designs right inside Elementor. Add soft blurs, subtle transparency, and frosted-glass styling to your containers for a sleek, high-end look.

Whether you’re designing minimalistic cards, floating panels, or stylish hero sections, Silica’s glass effect works seamlessly with Elementor’s native controls — no coding required.
sections.installation:
Installing Silica

  1. Download Silica Lite from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from your Plugins list.
  3. Once activated, you’ll see a “Silica” panel in your WordPress admin and new style controls in Elementor containers.

Applying Silica Effects in Elementor

  1. Open any page with Elementor.
  2. Select an existing container or create a new blank one.
  3. Go to the “Style” tab of the container. Scroll down and toggle “Enable Silica” to activate the effect.
